name: touhou-chasing-dream
description: 逐梦东方圈 — online multiplayer edition

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @tcd/server" "npm run dev -w @tcd/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tcd/client && npm run build -w @tcd/server
scripts.e2e:all: npm run build && node e2e/run.mjs --players all --games 2 && node e2e/tabs.mjs && node e2e/local.mjs --seats 5 && node e2e/mobile.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run e2e:all
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/client
